title: Grading settings
description: Choose who grades your learners' Writing and Speaking, and how.

graderHint.CENTER: Work that needs a teacher goes to your centre's teachers' queue.
graderHint.ENGLISH9X: Work that needs a teacher goes to English9x teachers' queue.

modeHint: With a mode that includes a teacher, learners' work is put in the queue of the grader you chose.
enterpriseLocked: An enterprise's learners are always graded by English9x with AI, so this setting is locked. Centre teachers and teacher modes are for centres only.

errors.notAllowed: An enterprise cannot choose centre teachers or a teacher mode: its learners are always graded by English9x with AI.
errors.failed: Could not save the settings. Please try again.
errors.loadFailed: Could not load the grading settings.
